d.sess.warm.label: LOCAL_MEASUREMENT
d.sess.warm.what: follow-up answer on the same session

d.sess.stop.label: LOCAL_MEASUREMENT
d.sess.stop.what: POST .../sessions/{id}:stop until the session reads idle

d.sess.resume.label: LOCAL_MEASUREMENT
d.sess.resume.what: next answer on the stopped session

d.sess.server.label: LOCAL_MEASUREMENT
d.sess.server.what: every turn: response completed_at minus created_at as recorded by the service (whole seconds)

d.sess.state_kept.label: LOCAL_MEASUREMENT
d.sess.state_kept.what: files: the file written before stop read back unchanged after resume; conversation: the question count kept growing across stop and resume

d.sess.pods.label: LOCAL_MEASUREMENT
d.sess.pods.what: session pods that appeared during the three runs (kubectl get pods -w; order and ages, no timestamps)
